question: La Tourangelle avocado oil parent company
markdown:
La Tourangelle
does not have a large corporate parent company
. It is an independent, family-owned and operated French-American business led by founder and CEO Matthieu Kohlmeyer, with roots originating from a family-run mill in France and operations based in Woodland, California.
